source.title: Downside risk and the cross-section of cryptocurrency returns

hypothesis: Cryptocurrencies with higher lagged downside semivariance earn higher subsequent weekly returns as compensation for downside risk.
universe: Frozen ex-ante set of Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals already listed by 2021-12-31, including later-delisted contracts when data exist. Each Monday retain top 50 by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume among contracts with exact history.
feature: Mean squared negative daily close-to-close return over W prior completed UTC days.
portfolio: Equal-weight market-neutral long highest-downside-risk quintile and short lowest-downside-risk quintile, 0.5 gross per side.
execution: All feature/liquidity inputs end Sunday; rebalance Monday 00:00 UTC open and hold to next Monday open.
development_gate: Canonical rank IC >0.02 with HAC p<0.05, positive high-minus-low downside-risk spread, canonical net Sharpe >0.70 and total return >0, and at least 2/3 windows positive after costs.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0; OOS rank IC >0.02; positive at 2x costs; at least 2/3 windows positive; 2024 and 2025 non-negative; max drawdown <35%; excluding BTC/ETH positive; excluding strongest contributor positive; DSR reported.
